One striking adult woman Sorcerer with warm deep-brown skin, graceful natural features, luminous thoughtful eyes, and loosely pinned dark curls with a few escaped strands. One hand holds the note naturally, the other loosely cups the small flame without theatrical gesturing. The hands must be anatomically credible and the paper must sit naturally between the fingers. This is an observed life moment, not a promotional pose.

CLOTHING
Grounded late-medieval scholarly clothing, not fantasy mage armor: a simple fitted charcoal wool scholar's gown/doublet over an undyed linen collar, modest practical sleeves, a narrow leather belt with one ink-stained document pouch. A single rich ultramarine-blue mantle/scarf is the only bright accent and creates the memorable silhouette. No red, no purple, no gold filigree, no gemstones, no corset, no high armor collar, no shoulder armor, no ornate magic costume, no cleavage-focused design.

Match the golden references' beautiful hand-painted anime watercolor/gouache language: delicate expressive facial painting, subtle blush and warm reflected firelight, visible dry-brush paper texture, selective ink-like edge accents, slightly irregular handmade contours, quiet areas of pigment wash, poetic rather than glossy. Predominantly charcoal, parchment cream, warm brown skin, and ONE saturated ultramarine/cobalt accent. The tiny flame may provide restrained amber reflected light but must not become a second clothing palette. Maintain luminous midtones so the face and blue accent remain alive against a dark combat field.

Portrait orientation, close waist-up three-quarter view, face large and readable. Her shoulders are slightly turned as though interrupted while working. Keep a clear 6–8 percent transparent gap above every hair strand; the head must never touch the top. Keep all body parts, hands, flame, and paper fully inside the canvas. Bottom garment may continue off-canvas naturally below the waist. Soft cloth may approach the sides and dissolve with sparse paper-white watercolor dry-brush feathering into transparency, but never hard-clip a hand, head, or anatomy. No zoomed-out full body.

A single isolated character cutout on genuine transparent alpha, no background, no room, no furniture, no floor shadow, no frame, no text, no symbols, no halo, no checkerboard pattern. Clean usable portrait asset edges while retaining intentional watercolor feathering.

NEGATIVE
Do not make her smile or pose at camera. No smug expression. No runway stance.
